## 中文原文

你晚上打算做番茄炒蛋。先从冰箱拿出番茄和鸡蛋，把番茄洗干净切成块，打了两个鸡蛋搅匀。锅里倒油烧热，先把鸡蛋炒好盛出来，再炒番茄，等番茄出汁后把鸡蛋倒回去一起翻炒，加点盐和糖调味，简单的家常菜就做好了。

## English translation

I decided to make scrambled eggs with tomatoes for dinner.

I got the tomatoes and eggs out of the fridge, washed the tomatoes and chopped them up, then cracked two eggs and beat them well.

I heated some oil in a pan, scrambled the eggs first, and set them aside.

Next I stir-fried the tomatoes until they softened and released their juice, then tossed the eggs back in.

I seasoned with a little salt and sugar, and that was it—my simple home-cooked dish was done.
